stations.title: Theo
stations.say: The site has to come up!

stations.title: Saved file
stations.text: Cut off halfway through the fig card.

captions: Maps and Sets count the sales now. Theo needs the catalogue saved to a file.
Last week saving stopped halfway, and the shop page was only an error.
You save data as JSON text, load it back, and catch what a broken file throws.
The broken file gives an empty catalogue, and the shop page comes up.
The catalogue is done: cards, counts and copies that are saved and loaded safely.
